topic: What trade-offs exist between the filter's compact size and integration with phased array antennas for satellite coverage optimization?
consensus_response: Compact filter size increases inter-element spacing effects, exacerbating grating lobes and interference, degrading angular coverage and link budget. Metamaterials and 3D printing can mitigate trade-offs by optimizing filter design, improving directivity and reducing interference, thus preserving link budget performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems require balancing compactness with angular coverage, beam steering, and directivity, considering antenna gain, inter-satellite distance, and control accuracy.
